topic: Concurrency and Sync Primitives with Mutex Examples
explanation: Concurrency allows multiple tasks to proceed seemingly at the same time, improving performance.  However, shared resources require synchronization to prevent race conditions (unpredictable behavior due to unsynchronized access). Synchronization primitives, like mutexes (mutual exclusion locks), coordinate access to shared resources, ensuring data consistency and program correctness within a computer system.
